name: 天机蛊
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE slender floating Gu that at first looks like a dragonfly but on closer inspection is a SOFT WILLOW TWIG with leaf-like wings. Length half an adult arm canonical, thin flexible continuous elongated willow-branch body with gentle shallow curve, not woody chunky stick, no humanoid face or normal centipede legs. Exactly SEVEN PAIRS of thin leafy gauze wings, seven along EACH side, 14 individual slender leaf-shaped membranes, spaced clearly along same single central twig, all visible without overlap swallowing roots. Display slightly oblique near-top view, main twig diagonal lower left to upper right, wings gently spread in a symmetrical rhythm like seven opposing willow leaf pairs. Wings greenish, exceptionally thin like sheer gauze, delicate vein lines and realistic edge transmission; organic soft greenish-brown slender twig-body, muted celadon translucency, not precious metal, gold, crystal, mechanical dragonfly, blunt oval leaves or feathers. Full object slowly drifting weightless in EMPTY muted grey-green/blue air, spacious quiet gradation, absolutely no tree branches background, forest, floor, sparks or cosmic sky. Physical soft back-side light catches every leaf wing's subtle membrane thickness; modest dark central body readable. No four-wing ordinary dragonfly, butterfly, many detached leaves or second creature. Uncanny branch-like living Gu, calm and airy, no giant eyes.
